messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: SLO breach detected for /v1/stream in region us-east-1. p95 rising > 800ms, p99 > 2.5s. Pattern: streaming stalls + prolonged token generation. Auto-page to #incidents and oncall.

alex: I'm looking. Seeing a huge spike in prefix cache miss rate right around 2039000000 deploy window. Miss rate ~ 85% for prefix-v3 keys in us-east-1.

maya: That deploy was the prefix-hash rewrite (prefix-hash v3) — we rolled canaries earlier today. @sam did the rollout.

sam: Confirmed. We deployed prefix-hash v3 at 2026-03-14T12:55:00Z (build 2039000000). Canary looked fine but traffic volume changed after autoscale; may have exposed skew.

alex: Quick metrics dump:
```
# internal metrics
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/v1/cache/prefix?region=us-east-1" | jq '.prefix_v3 | {miss_rate, p95_ms, p99_ms}'
# -> {"miss_rate": 0.87, "p95_ms": 620, "p99_ms": 2800}
```

jen: Logs show streaming stalls with repeated cache lookup fallthroughs, then long tail on backend model workers. Example trace:
```
stream-request id=abc123 | prefix_key_lookup miss -> backend fetch -> kv cache populate -> latency 2.9s
```

bryan: Dedicated pools (reserved capacity) are fine — this is mostly affecting shared hosted pool. Impact: ~12 hosted tenants show degraded streaming experience. Top affected: Acme Health, NomadMaps, Cartwheel.

alex: Immediate mitigation plan (live):
- divert shared-hosted traffic for model-families X,Y to fallback routing (prefer warm buckets with legacy prefix-v2)
- increase prefix cache TTL temporarily to avoid churn
- if needed, rollback prefix-hash v3 to v2 on shared path

maya: I'll flip routing rule to prefer legacy hash for host pools. Doing a quick small change to routing policy now.

opsbot: Executing routing change: set routing.preference.shared->legacy-hash v2 for models [X,Y] in us-east-1. Change id=chg-2039000123. :white_check_mark:

alex: After routing change — observing immediate drop in miss_rate for affected models. p95 down to ~350ms, p99 trending down.

sam: Preparing rollback play if we don't see stable numbers in 10m. Rollback command used in staging:
```
/ci rollback service=prefix-hash build=2039000000 --env=prod-shared
```

jen: Also starting targeted warmup for affected cache shards (us-east-1). Running warmup script for top keys for Acme Health and NomadMaps.
```
python infra/scripts/warmup_prefix_cache.py --region us-east-1 --keys-file recent_hot_keys.json
```

bryan: Customer impact note for HandOff: ~12 tenants saw elevated tail latency; no circuit-breaker or errors returned to customers, just higher token latency and streaming stalls. Support notified Acme Health & NomadMaps (severity: medium).

alex: Quick diagnostics: prefix-v3 key distribution shows heavy skew to 2 shards -> eviction pressure. Likely hash change altered key entropy.

maya: After warmup + routing preference: metrics at 15m post-change:
- overall miss_rate (prefix_v3): 0.28
- p95: 320ms
- p99: 780ms

alex: Good improvement. We'll keep routing pref to v2 for shared-hosted until we validate prefix-v3 hash distribution in a controlled canary with traffic shaping.

sam: Filing follow-up engineering ticket: PREFIXHASH-INVEST-2039. Tasks: simulate production key distribution, run offline hash-entropy analysis, add canary traffic phase gate.

jen: Postmortem owners: alex (triage/mitigation), sam (root cause & fix), maya (routing/rollback automation), bryan (customer comms). I'll create the incident doc template.

opsbot: Paging: scheduling handoff to night oncall @maya at 2039000900. :spiral_calendar: 

maya: Taking handoff. I'll monitor for 2hrs and if stable I'll close incident and follow up with a rollback-retrospective. Anyone else have outstanding actions?

alex: I'll leave logs + queries in the incident doc. Add a note to not re-roll prefix-hash v3 without entropy test. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED -> routing fallback + warmup applied. Monitoring for recurrence. Incident window: start=2039000123 end=2039000960.
